Soupe de butternut et légumes roti 

Ingrédients : 
🔸1 courge butternut
🔸1 oignon rouge 
🔸2 poivrons
🔸Une tête d'ail
🔸Tomates cerises
🔸Lait de coco 
🔸bouillon de légumes
🔸Thym, romarin, paprika, cumin, poivre noir 
🔸un filet d’huile pimentée
🔸(Optionnel) Coriandre fraîche pour garnir

Préparation:
📍Préchauffage & préparation des légumes
📍Préchauffez votre four à 200°C
📍Épluchez et coupez la courge butternut en cubes.
📍Coupez l’oignon rouge, les poivrons et les tomates.
📍Écrasez l’ail et râpe un peu de gingembre.
📍Placez tous les légumes sur une plaque de cuisson.
📍Ajoutez : thym, romarin, paprika, cumin, poivre noir, sel et un filet d’huile
📍Mélangez pour bien enrober
📍Mettre au four pendant 30–40 minutes, jusqu’à ce que les légumes soient tendres et légèrement dorés
📍Transférez les légumes rôtis dans un blender 
📍Ajoutez du bouillon de légumes et du lait de coco.
📍Mixez jusqu’à obtenir une texture lisse et velouté
📍Ajoutez une touche de lait de coco, un filet d’huile pimentée et un peu de coriandre fraîche.

Tacos de carottes sans gluten

Ingredients pour 4 tacos :
🔸4 à 5 carottes
🔸50 g de fromage râpé
🔸2 œufs
🔸Un peu de ciboulette
🔸Une pincée de sel

Pour la garniture :
🔸1 petit oignon
🔸150 à 200 g de blanc de poulet
🔸De la salade au choix
🔸Du tzatziki

Préparation :
📍Râpez les carottes finement.
📍Mélangez les carottes râpées avec le fromage, les œufs, la ciboulette hachée et une pincée de sel.
📍Formez les tortillas : déposez la préparation sur une plaque recouverte de papier cuisson et façonnez 4 cercles (pas trop fins).
📍Faites cuire au four à 180 °C (chaleur traditionnelle) pendant environ 20 à 25 minutes, jusqu’à ce qu’ils soient dorés et légèrement croustillants.
📍Faites revenir l’oignon et le poulet dans un peu d’huile, salez et poivrez selon votre goût.
📍Garnissez les tacos avec la salade, le tzatziki, le poulet et les oignons.
📍Roulez et dégustez aussitôt ! 😋

👉 Ces tacos sont sans gluten, riches en légumes et parfaits pour un repas sain, original et plein de saveurs 🧡

Salade d'automne 

Ingrédients pour 2 à 3 personnes :
🔸400 g de carottes
🔸200 g de fromage mozzarella spéciale cuisson
🔸1 boîte de pois chiches (environ 250 g égouttés)
🔸2 poignées de roquette fraîche
🔸50 g de noix de pécan 
🔸2 c. à soupe d’huile d’olive
🔸1/2 c. à café de paprika doux
🔸1/2 c. à café de cumin 
🔸Sel et poivre noir, au goût

Pour la vinaigrette citronnée :
🔸3 c. à soupe d’huile d’olive
🔸Le jus d’un citron
🔸1 c. à café de miel ou de sirop d’érable
🔸1 c. à café de moutarde
🔸Sel et poivre noir, au goût

Préparation :
📍Préchauffez le four à 200°C (chaleur tournante).
📍Tapissez une grande plaque de cuisson de papier sulfurisé.
📍Épluchez les carottes et coupez-les en bâtonnets. 
📍Égouttez et rincez les pois chiches.
📍Placez-les sur la plaque, arrosez d’huile d’olive, saupoudrez de paprika, cumin, sel et poivre. 
📍Mélangez bien pour tout enrober.
📍Faites rôtir au four pendant 25 à 30 minutes, jusqu’à ce que les carottes soient tendres et légèrement dorées, et les pois chiches croustillants.
📍Pendant ce temps, coupez le fromage en tranches. Faites-le dorer à la poêle (sans matière grasse) 2 à 3 minutes de chaque côté, jusqu’à ce qu’il soit bien doré.
📍Dans un petit bol, mélangez l’huile d’olive, le jus de citron, le miel (ou sirop d’érable), la moutarde, le sel et le poivre. 
📍Fouettez pour obtenir une sauce homogène
📍Dans un grand saladier, disposez la roquette, les carottes rôties, les pois chiches et le fromage
📍Arrosez de vinaigrette, mélangez délicatement et parsemez de noix de pécan.
📍Servez tiède ou à température ambiante.

C’est une salade équilibrée, gourmande et pleine d’énergie — parfaite pour un déjeuner sain ou un dîner léger ! 🥰

Crêpes de courgettes

Ingrédients pour 5 crêpes :
🔸1 courgette d’environ 120 g
🔸1 œuf
🔸60 g de farine de blé (ou de farine d’épeautre)
🔸1 cuillère à soupe d’huile d’olive extra-vierge
🔸1 pincée de sel

Préparation :
📍Lavez la courgette, retirez les extrémités, puis coupez-la en dés. 
📍Mixez-la avec le reste des ingrédients à l’aide d’un blender ou d’un mixeur.
📍Lorsque la pâte est prête, prélevez-en une portion avec une louche et faites cuire des crêpes des deux côtés dans une poêle antiadhésive.
📍Avant la cuisson, graissez légèrement la poêle avec un peu de papier absorbant imbibé d’huile, puis faites-la chauffer 2 minutes.
📍Versez la pâte et laissez cuire chaque crêpe jusqu’à ce qu’elle soit dorée des deux côtés.
📍Une fois cuites, laissez-les refroidir puis garnissez-les selon vos envies. 😋

Ingrédients pour 2 personnes :

📍Dans un bol, mélangez les tomates cerises coupées, les olives, les câpres, le thym et la ciboulette.

📍Faites cuire dans une friteuse à air à 180°C pendant 10 à 12 minutes.
📍Servez aussitôt, avec un peu de persil frais si vous le souhaitez.

12/20 Repas Rapide et sain spéciale rentrée 
Saumon au miel et paprika & salade d’avocat

Ingredients:
Pour le saumon :
🔸1 c. à s. de paprika fumé
🔸2 c. à s. de miel
🔸Ail en poudre, sel + poivre
🔸Un peu d’eau
🔸4 filets de saumon

Pour la salade à l’avocat :
🔸120 g de jeunes pousses d’épinards
🔸2 tasses de quinoa ou de couscous cuit
🔸250 g de tomates cerises
🔸1/2 petit oignon rouge
🔸2 avocats bien mûrs
🔸Le jus de 2 citrons verts
🔸Un filet de miel + d’huile d’olive
🔸Sel + poivre, selon votre goût

Préparation
📍Dans un petit bol, mélangez le paprika fumé, le miel, un peu d’ail en poudre, du sel, du poivre et un peu d’eau afin d’obtenir une sauce homogène.
📍Badigeonnez les filets de saumon avec cette marinade.
📍Faites chauffer une poêle grill ou un barbecue.
📍Faites cuire les filets de saumon 3 à 4 minutes de chaque côté (selon leur épaisseur), jusqu’à ce qu’ils soient tendres et légèrement caramélisé
📍Lavez et essorez les jeunes pousses d’épinards.
📍Dans un grand saladier, ajoutez le quinoa (ou le couscous) cuit, les tomates cerises coupées en deux, l’oignon rouge finement haché et les avocats en dés.
📍Assaisonnez avec le jus de citron vert, un filet de miel, un peu d’huile d’olive, du sel et du poivre. Mélangez délicatement.
📍Disposez la salade d’avocat dans des bols.
📍Déposez un filet de saumon grillé par-dessus.
📍Servez immédiatement et dégustez chaud avec la salade fraîche.

So many people struggle with inflammation.
 
In fact, anti-inflammatory drugs are the #1-selling drugs in the world.
 
Here are the 10 most common causes of inflammation.
 
1. Gluten consumption and food allergies: Gluten can lead to a leaky gut, a condition where food particles leak through the small intestine. Leaky gut is one of the most common causes of inflammation. Pinpointing a food allergy can also help clear up gut inflammation.
 
2. Ultra-processed food ingredients: Ultra-processed foods like synthetic sugars, modified food starches, and seed oils go through several industrial processes to the point that they no longer resemble their original form. These foods cause free-radical damage and inflammation in the body.
 
3. Viruses: Viruses can go in and out of remission, causing inflammatory conditions that come and go. This is often triggered by stress, which increases your cortisol levels and suppresses your immune system.
 
4. Insulin resistance: Frequent eating and carb consumption lead to insulin resistance. Most of the population is insulin-resistant.
 
5. Lack of cortisol: Chronic stress over a long period of time can lead to cortisol resistance.
 
6. Old injuries: Lack of movement and a sedentary lifestyle can lead to inflammation.
 
7. Sludge in bile ducts: Without adequate bile salts, bile sludge can back up into the liver, causing right shoulder pain and rhomboid pain. This can be corrected by a healthy diet.
 
8. Too much iron: This is typically caused by a genetic issue and is more common in men.
 
9. Hypoxia: Conditions like COPD, cirrhosis of the liver, clogged arteries, and sleep apnea can cause hypoxia, a lack of oxygen.
 
10. Uric acid: Uric acid is one of the most common causes of high blood pressure and comes from high fructose consumption.

The MOST Dangerous Eating Habit? Constant Snacking ⚠️

Most people focus on what they eat…

But how often you eat can matter too.

If you’re constantly snacking from morning until night, you’re repeatedly giving your body more energy to process—especially when those snacks are refined carbohydrates and sugary foods.

Over time, frequent unnecessary snacking can make it harder to:

🩸 Maintain stable blood sugar

🔥 Tap into stored energy between meals

🍽️ Recognize true hunger and fullness

⚡ Avoid excess calorie intake

💪 Maintain good metabolic health

Here’s the important distinction:

Snacking itself isn’t inherently dangerous.

The bigger problem is mindless, frequent snacking—especially on ultra-processed foods—when you aren’t actually hungry.

💡 Try this instead:

Build satisfying meals around quality protein, healthy fats, and non-starchy vegetables.

Then give your body some time between meals instead of automatically reaching for another snack.

👉 Try eliminating unnecessary snacks for one week and pay attention to your hunger, cravings, and energy levels.

Save this post and share it with someone who snacks all day.

One of the BEST Nutrients for Your Heart: CoQ10 ❤️⚡

Your heart requires an enormous amount of energy to keep beating 24/7.

And there’s one nutrient that plays a critical role in that energy production:

⚡ Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10)

CoQ10 is a naturally occurring antioxidant found in nearly every cell of your body, with especially high concentrations in energy-demanding organs like the heart.

CoQ10 helps support:

❤️ Cellular energy production in heart muscle

⚡ Mitochondrial function

🛡️ Protection against oxidative stress

🩸 Healthy blood vessel function

💓 Overall cardiovascular health

Your body produces CoQ10 naturally, but levels tend to decline with age. Certain medications, including statins, can also lower CoQ10 levels.

🥩 FOOD SOURCES OF CoQ10:

Organ meats like heart and liver are among the richest sources.

You can also find CoQ10 in:

🐟 Fatty fish
🥩 Beef
🐔 Chicken
🥦 Broccoli
🥬 Spinach

💡 CoQ10 isn’t literally a “food”—it’s a compound your body produces and that you can also obtain from certain foods and supplements.

Salmon vs. Cod Liver: Which Is More Anti-Inflammatory? 🐟🔥

Both are nutrient-dense foods, but if we’re looking at the overall combination of nutrients involved in supporting a healthy inflammatory response...

🏆 COD LIVER TAKES THE WIN.

Here’s why:

🥫 COD LIVER

Cod liver provides a unique combination of:

🐟 EPA + DHA omega-3 fatty acids
☀️ Vitamin D
👁️ Preformed vitamin A

EPA and DHA are involved in the production of compounds that help regulate and resolve inflammatory responses.

Vitamin D also plays an important role in immune regulation, while vitamin A supports normal immune function and tissue health.

🐟 SALMON

Salmon is still an excellent anti-inflammatory food.

It provides:

🐟 EPA + DHA
💪 High-quality protein
☀️ Vitamin D
🛡️ Selenium
⚡ Vitamin B12

And because you typically eat a larger serving of salmon, it can be an excellent way to increase your overall omega-3 intake.

So why choose cod liver?

🔥 Its combination of omega-3s + vitamins A and D makes it an exceptionally concentrated source of nutrients involved in immune and inflammatory regulation.

The key is portion size: cod liver is extremely nutrient-dense, particularly in preformed vitamin A, so more isn’t necessarily better.

3 Signs You Could Have Parasites 🦠⚠️

Parasites can sometimes live in the digestive system without causing obvious symptoms at first. But certain persistent problems may be worth investigating.

Here are 3 possible signs:

1️⃣ Persistent digestive problems

Frequent bloating, gas, diarrhea, abdominal discomfort, nausea, or unexplained changes in bowel movements can occur with certain intestinal parasites.

2️⃣ Unexplained weight loss

Some parasitic infections can interfere with digestion, appetite, or nutrient absorption, potentially causing weight loss without an obvious explanation.

3️⃣ Persistent fatigue or weakness

Certain parasites can contribute to nutrient deficiencies, blood loss, or digestive problems that may leave you feeling unusually tired or weak.

⚠️ These symptoms do not automatically mean you have parasites. Many other digestive and medical conditions can cause the same symptoms.

If these problems persist—especially after travel, contaminated food or water, or another possible exposure—proper testing can help determine the actual cause.

Mi sono laureata in Scienze Linguistiche con 110 e Lode ✨e non mi vergogno ad ammettere che:

1. Tantissime volte non mi sono sentita all’altezza.
Guardavo gli altri parlare con scioltezza, capire tutto al volo, sembrare sempre super sicuri, mentre io avevo l’impressione di dovermi impegnare il doppio per ottenere gli stessi risultati.

2. Studiare non è sempre stato “passione”.
Ci sono stati esami che ho affrontato solo per portarli a casa. Non sempre ero davvero interessata a tutto, e a volte preparavo gli esami solo per il voto, non perché quella materia mi facesse brillare gli occhi.

3. Dopo la laurea mi sono buttata nel mondo del lavoro, ma in un ambito che non ho mai sentito mio.
Facevo del mio meglio, imparavo, mi impegnavo, ma dentro sentivo che non era quello che volevo davvero.
E ci ho messo tempo ad accettarlo, a non giudicarmi, a capire che non è un fallimento, è esperienza.

La verità?
Nessun percorso è lineare.
E non c’è un’età giusta per cambiare, crescere o ricominciare.
C’è solo quel momento in cui trovi il coraggio di ascoltarti davvero.

4. Oggi sogno di prendere una seconda laurea in un settore completamente diverso.
E non mi spaventa non essere più “piccolissima”.
Mi spaventa di più l’idea di non provarci, non appena ci saranno le condizioni giuste per farlo.

➡️Se ti rispecchi in queste parole, lascia un ❤️ e ricorda: non sei solo/a.

كرّري العملية مع باقي المكونات.

Tofu brouillés aux tomates 🍅 

Avec les dernières tomates de la saison, j’ai fais une recette de toast réconfortante & protéiné. 

Pour une personne :
- 2 tranches de pain au levain
- 2 cac de fromage frais
- 1 bloc de tofu nature 
- épices : curry, cumin, sel

Toppings au choix : graines de courges, tome fleurie (marche aussi avec de la fêta, de la crème épaisse ou simplement comme ça 🤍)

Je commence par faire cuire deux tomates moyennes ou une grosse tomate dans un filet d’huile d’olive. J’ajoute mon tofu émietté et les épices. Je mélange bien pour obtenir une texture crémeuse. On peut ajouter une pointe de crème liquide. Je dresse le mélange tofu/tomate sur mes toasts grillé & tartinés de fromage frais. J’ajoute mes topping et je peux déguster 🧡

Un petit bout d’été dans mon dessert de rentrée 🍓☀️

J’avais envie de prolonger un peu les saveurs estivales avec ces fraises Charlotte trouvées au marché. Une variété remontante qui se déguste jusqu’à l’automne : l’occasion parfaite de refaire l’un de mes desserts préférés, le riz au lait à la vanille. 🤍

Riz au lait vanillé & fraises Charlotte 🍓

Pour 4 personnes :

100g de riz rond
600 ml de lait entier
1 gousse de vanille
2 c. à soupe de miel
100 g de fraises Charlotte
1 c. à café de jus de citron
2 c. à soupe de yaourt grec pour servir

Je fais cuire doucement le riz avec le lait, la vanille et 1 cuillère à soupe de miel pendant environ 30 min, en remuant régulièrement, jusqu’à obtenir une texture bien crémeuse.

Je laisse refroidir idéalement toute une nuit au frais. Le lendemain, je détends le riz au lait avec un petit peu de lait si besoin. C’est bon aussi un peu tiède si vous n’avez pas envie d’attendre la nuit.

Pendant ce temps, je fais revenir les fraises avec 1 cuillère à soupe miel et le jus de citron pendant quelques minutes.

Je verse le riz au lait dans un bol, j’ajoute le yaourt grec, les fraises encore légèrement tièdes... et c’est tout.

🍓 Simple, de saison et vraiment réconfortant ❤️

Fruit Lollies 🍓 
Full recipe below, send to a friend who would love this 📤⁣ 
 
Post by @buzzfeedtasty

📝 Ingredients (for 12 lollies)
* 1 banana, sliced
* 3 cups strawberry (300 g), reserve half, and chop into small pieces for step 2
* 2 cups blueberry (200 g), reserve half the berries for step 2
* 1 ½ cups raspberries (150 g), reserve half the berries for step 2
* 1 ¼ cups yogurt (300 g)

👩‍🍳 Preparation
1. Blend together the banana, half of the strawberries, half of the blueberries, half of the raspberries, and all of the yogurt in a food processor.
 
2. Remove the blade, then stir in the rest of the fruit. 
 
3. Pour this mixture into a bread tin and put 12 lollipop sticks in, evenly spaced apart.

4. Freeze overnight. 
 
5. Allow to defrost for approx 15-20 minutes.

6. Remove from tin, and cut the lollipops out with a sharp knife. 

7. Enjoy!

Cilantro Lime Chicken & Veggie Rice Meal Prep 🍗 
 
Full recipe below, send it to a friend who’d love this! 
 
By @buzzfeedtasty
 
📝 Ingredients (for 4 servings)
* oil, of your preference, to taste
* 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast (455 g), cubed
* salt, to taste
* pepper, to taste
* 1 lime, juiced
* ⅓ cup fresh cilantro (15 g), minced
* 1 red bell pepper, diced
* ½ red onion, diced
* 2 cloves garlic, minced
* 1 bag riced cauliflower
* 1 cup corn (175 g), steamed
* ½ teaspoon chili powder, optional
* 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained, optional
* lime, cut into wedges, optional

👩‍🍳 Preparation
1. Heat preferred cooking oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken, season with salt and pepper, and cook until cooked through and no longer pink. 
 
2. Add lime juice and cilantro. Stir to combine. Remove chicken from pan, place on a plate, and set aside. 
 
3. Add a little more oil to pan if needed, then add red onion, bell pepper, and garlic. Stir to combine. Allow to cook until onion begins to turn transparent, stirring occasionally. 

4. Add riced cauliflower, corn, and chili powder. Cook until cauliflower is soft and remove from heat. 
 
5. Distribute black beans, chicken, and cauliflower mixture evenly between 4 containers. Top with a wedge of lime. 

6. This meal prep can be refrigerated for up to 4 days. 
 
7. Enjoy!

Potassium bromate is a flour additive used to make bread rise higher and bake faster. 

In 1999 the World Health Organization’s cancer research agency (IARC) classified it as a possible human carcinogen after it caused kidney and thyroid tumors in rats.

The European Union banned it in 1990, Canada in 1994, and China and the UK do not allow it either. In the United States the FDA still permits up to 75 parts per million in flour.

A 2026 EWG review found it in over 200 products sold in US stores.

The common generational refrain, “I ate that back in the day and I’m fine”, overlooks a critical reality: the food on supermarket shelves today is fundamentally different from the food of a few decades ago. When older generations were growing up, even packaged or convenient foods were made from relatively simple, recognizable whole ingredients. A loaf of bread contained flour, water, yeast, and salt, rather than a cocktail of chemical dough conditioners, texturizers, and extended shelf-life enzymes. Comparing the diet of the past to the diet of the present is a false equivalency, because the modern food supply chain has undergone a massive industrial shift, transforming traditional staples into highly engineered products.

Today, the prevalence of synthetic additives, artificial preservatives, and industrial substitutes has fundamentally altered the biological impact of what we eat. Modern ultra-processed foods are systematically loaded with high-fructose corn syrup, hydrogenated oils, chemical dyes, and artificial flavor enhancers designed to maximize shelf-life and trigger overeating. These modern synthetic compounds place a completely different metabolic burden on the human body compared to the simpler ingredients of the mid-20th century. Consequently, replicating the exact diet of “back in the day” using today’s standard grocery items means consuming a chemical cocktail that simply did not exist a generation ago.

Some of the most affordable traditional foods are also packed with nutrients 🥩🥚🌿

Liver is rich in vitamin A, B12, iron, copper, and choline. Gizzards provide lean protein, zinc, selenium, and B vitamins. Chicken feet, tripe, and oxtail contain connective tissue that becomes rich in gelatin when slow-cooked.

Heart provides protein, iron, B vitamins, taurine, and CoQ10, while kidneys are especially rich in B2, B12, selenium, iron, and zinc. Beef tongue offers protein and several important minerals, and eggs provide complete protein, choline, selenium, and fat-soluble vitamins.

The takeaway: nutritious eating doesn’t always require expensive foods. Traditional cuts and simple whole foods can add plenty of protein, vitamins, and minerals to a balanced diet.

Combine shredded chicken, lettuce, shredded carrot, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and chickpeas. Toss everything with a light yogurt dressing, fresh herbs, salt, and pepper. It’s protein-rich, creamy, crunchy, and works great for lunch or dinner.

2. Quinoa Salad 🥑
Start with cooked quinoa, then add carrot, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, corn, arugula, and avocado. Finish with a simple dressing made from lemon juice and olive oil. This one is fresh, filling, and packed with fiber, healthy fats, and plant-based nutrients.

3. Chickpea Salad 🌱
Mix chickpeas with red onion, tomato, cucumber, shredded carrot, mixed greens, and fresh parsley. Add a creamy tahini dressing and toss until evenly coated. It’s an easy plant-based option that keeps well for meal prep.

4. Vegetable Salad 🥦
Combine cooked broccoli, carrots, sweet potato, peas, corn, and green beans. Add fresh herbs and a mustard-yogurt dressing for extra flavor. Serve warm or chilled depending on your preference.

Meal-prep tip: Keep the dressing separate until you’re ready to eat if you want the vegetables and greens to stay extra fresh and crisp.

Cucumber sushi is such an easy way to turn a few simple ingredients into a fresh, crunchy, protein-packed snack or light meal 🥒🍣

For this version, you only need a few basics: long cucumber strips, cream cheese, canned tuna, shredded carrots, and optional sesame seeds or chopped green onions for topping.

Use a vegetable peeler or mandoline to slice the cucumber lengthwise into thin ribbons. Lay the ribbons side by side with a little overlap to create one large sheet. Pat them dry with a paper towel so the roll holds together better.

Spread a thin, even layer of cream cheese over the lower section of the cucumber sheet. Add drained canned tuna, then a layer of finely shredded carrots. Keep the filling fairly compact so it’s easier to roll.

Starting from the filled edge, carefully roll the cucumber sheet into a tight log. Chill it for a few minutes if you want cleaner slices, then cut into bite-size rounds. Finish with sesame seeds, green onions, herbs, or a little seasoning if you like.

It’s crisp, creamy, savory, and requires no cooking. You can also switch up the filling with shredded chicken, salmon, avocado, bell peppers, or your favorite spread.

We have power to prevent and reverse some chronic illnesses and it starts in our plates💪

Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a hormonal disorder common among women of reproductive age. Women with PCOS may have infrequent or prolonged menstrual periods or excess male hormone (androgen) levels. The ovaries may develop numerous small collections of fluid (follicles) and fail to regularly release eggs.
-

👉Complications: can include
• Infertility
• Gestational diabetes or pregnancy-induced high blood pressure
• Miscarriage or premature birth
• Nonalcoholic steatohepatitis 
• Metabolic syndrome  
• Type 2 diabetes or prediabetes
• Sleep apnea
• Depression, anxiety and eating disorders
• Abnormal uterine bleeding
• Cancer of the uterine lining (endometrial cancer)
• Obesity 

👉Diet and lifestyle tips to treat PCOS 

Treatment for PCOS usually starts with lifestyle changes like weight loss, diet, and exercise. 

✔Weight loss 
✔With PCOS, diet is a key part of a treatment plan. Any diet that helps you lose weight can help your condition. 

Studies comparing diets for PCOS have found that low-carbohydrate diets are effective for both weight loss and lowering insulin levels. 

✔A few studies have found that 30 minutes of moderate-intensity exercise at least three days a week can help women with PCOS lose weight. Losing weight with exercise also improves ovulation and insulin levels . 

Exercise is even more beneficial when combined with a healthy diet. Diet plus exercise helps you lose more weight than either intervention alone, and it lowers your risks for diabetes and heart disease.

📽credit: @drmarkhyman

Let's talk about Bloating. 

🎈It is important to remember, that a little bit of bloating is normal! Particularly after we’ve eaten a large meal, or a high fibre meal, and can actually be a good sign that our gut microbes are doing what they should. ⁣
⁣
🎈Bloating is the feeling of increased pressure in your intestine that in some cases may also cause a visible protrusion. But there is no one single cause of bloating, and it is much more complex than pointing the finger at what we’re eating.⁣
⁣
🎈Understanding how you bloat can tell you a lot about where it’s coming from! 

🎈Top bloat: this is when the bloating happens on both sides above your belly button. This can be due to a stomach or upper intestinal issue like:
✅ Gastroparesis
✅ Indigestion
✅ Drinking soda/carbonation 
✅ Swallowing too much air- Air can be swallowed in a number of ways - chewing gum, eating or drinking too quickly, drinking through a straw, and smoking. 
✅ Celiac disease 
✅ Food allergies 

🎈Bottom bloat: this is when the bloating happens on both sides below your belly button. This can be due to a mid-lower intestinal or colon issue like: 
✅ IBS
✅ Lactose intolerance 
✅ Constipation
✅ Don’t forget OB or GYN issues 🤰🏼 

🎈All-over bloat: It’s all over your abdomen and usually 
✅ Liver disease and ascites
✅ IBD - Crohns and ulcerative colitis 
✅ Abdomino-phrenic dyssynergia
✅ Intestinal obstruction

The fructose found naturally in fruits is packaged with fiber and antioxidants, which may help to explain why people experience positive health benefits when they eat fruits. Adding berries to a meal can help blunt an insulin spike from high glycemic foods, for instance. The fiber in fruits can help slow the release of the sugar, and fruit phytonutrients can help inhibit the transportation of sugar into our intestinal walls and bloodstream.⁠
⁠
Similarly, the fat found in whole plant-based foods comes packaged with health-promoting nutrients, such as fiber and phytonutrients. Nuts can help lower cholesterol and oxidation, as well as improve our arterial function and blood sugar levels. Just a few small servings of nuts a week may increase our lifespan and lower our cancer risk. Removing saturated animal fat from our diet and substituting in avocados may lead to a significant drop in cholesterol and triglycerides. However, simply adding avocado without also reducing saturated animal fat intake does not appear to result in any benefits to cholesterol.⁠
⁠

Here’s how you do it:

Makes 1 monster, 2 jumbo, 4 minis

🌟 1/4 C almond meal
🌟 1 tbsp cacao
🌟 1 tbsp almond butter — I use @99th_monkey smooth, unsalted
🌟 1 tbsp maple syrup — I use sugar-free/monk fruit maple
🌟 1 tbsp @lakanto monk fruit sweetener — I use 1/2 classic + 1/2 brown (or granulated sweetener of choice)
🌟 1/2 tsp vanilla

🌟 Dark choc, roughly chopped — measure with your ❤️

🌟 1 scoop collagen — optional; won’t change the taste or texture, but adds a hit of protein

✳️ Freeze for 10 mins
✳️ Scoop + roll dough into a ball, then gently flatten the tops

Whipped Feta 
8 oz. feta, crumbled 
1/2 cup olive oil 
1/4 cup whipped cream cheese 
1/4 cup water 
lemon zest 
1 tbsp oregano 
1-2 tbsp honey 
Potatoes 
10 yukon potatoes 
1/4 cup olive oil 
1 tsp salt & pepper
1 tsp paprika

Ingredients (for 10 servings)
8 lb bone-in lamb roast with fat cap (3.8 kg)
12 cloves garlic, divided
½ cup olive oil (120 g)
⅓ cup whole grain mustard (80 g), plus more for serving
1 lemon, juiced
10 sprigs fresh rosemary, stemmed and leaves finely chopped, plus whole sprigs for serving
10 sprigs fresh thyme, stemmed and leaves finely chopped, plus whole sprigs for serving
1 ½ tablespoons sea salt
1 tablespoon freshly ground black pepper
¾ cup dry white wine (180 mL)
2 ½ lb yukon gold potato (1.2 kg), halved
flaky sea salt

Preparation
2-3 hours before roasting, prepare lamb. Use a sharp knife to make 15 to 20 incisions, each about 2 inches deep, through fat cap on top of the meat. Thinly slice 3 cloves of garlic and use your fingers to press slices into the incisions.
In a blender, combine remaining 9 garlic cloves, olive oil, mustard, lemon juice, rosemary leaves, thyme leaves, salt, and pepper. Blend until a paste forms.
Spread paste evenly over the lamb. Let marinate at room temperature for 2 to 3 hours.
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place lamb on a roasting rack in a roasting pan and pour wine into the bottom of the pan. Roast for 15 minutes.
Remove pan from oven and reduce heat to 325°F.
Arrange potatoes, cut side down, in the roasting pan and place the lamb on the rack on top. Roast for 2 hours, tossing potatoes and basting lamb with the roasting liquid halfway through.
Transfer potatoes to a platter, baste the lamb again with remaining pan juices, and return lamb to the oven. Continue to roast, basting often, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of the leg reaches 130°F (medium-rare), 45 minutes to 2 hours more, depending on thickness. (As a general rule, the lamb should roast 20 minutes per pound for medium-rare).
Transfer lamb to a platter and set aside to rest for 20 minutes. While lamb rests, return potatoes to roasting pan, season with flaky salt, and warm in oven until just heated through, about 20 minutes. Return potatoes to serving platter.
Carve lamb into ½-inch (1 cm) thick slices and arrange on platter with potatoes, garnished with rosemary and thyme sprigs.

nonstick cooking spray, for greasing

Preparation
Preheat the oven to 350˚F (180˚C).
Make the maple cream cheese filling: In a medium bowl, combine the cream cheese, lemon juice, vanilla, and maple syrup. Stir until smooth and creamy. Set aside.
Make the pumpkin cake: Sift the flour into a large bowl and add the brown sugar, cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, ginger, cloves, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Whisk to combine.
In a medium bowl, combine the pumpkin puree, vegetable oil, water, and vanilla. Whisk well.
Gradually add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, folding with a rubber spatula just until combined. Do not overmix the batter.
Generously grease a bundt pan with nonstick spray.
Add 3 cups (675 G) of pumpkin batter to the pan and spread evenly. Then, scoop the cream cheese filling over the batter, making a ring. Top with the remaining batter and spread to cover the filling.

Remove the cake from the oven and let cool for 15 minutes before inverting to remove from the pan.

AIL CONFIT MAISON 

Une recette toute simple mais qui change tout. Parfait sur une tartine, avec une viande, des légumes etc...

 Ingrédients

	•	De l’ail 
	•	De l’huile d’olive
	•	Laurier, thym, romarin

Au four

Épluchez l’ail. Mettez-le dans un plat avec les herbes, recouvrez d’huile d’olive.

Four à 175-180°C, environ 30 minutes. Surveillez, ça dépend du four.

L’ail doit être tendre et fondant, sans caraméliser.

À la poêle

Même principe, à feu très doux. Ne pas laisser caraméliser, sinon le goût devient trop fort et amer. Une fois fondant, retirez du feu et laissez tiédir.

Conservation

Mettez l’ail dans un bocal propre, recouvrez avec l’huile de cuisson et les herbes. Fermez et gardez au frigo.

À consommer dans les 2 semaines.

* 50 g de beurre mou

Pour la dorure :

À la sortie du four :

* Beurre fondu + ail + persil + une pincée de sel.

👩🏽‍🍳 Préparation :
Mélangez la farine, le sel, le sucre et la levure. Ajoutez le lait tiède, l’huile d’olive et le blanc d’œuf, puis pétrissez jusqu’à obtenir une pâte homogène. Incorporez ensuite le beurre mou et continuez de pétrir jusqu’à ce que la pâte soit souple et presque non collante.

Laissez lever 1 h 30. Dégazez la pâte, puis divisez-la en portions d’environ 40 g. Aplatissez légèrement chaque boule, ajoutez un cube d’emmental au centre, refermez et façonnez une boule.

Déposez-les sur une plaque, laissez lever encore 30 minutes, puis badigeonnez-les du mélange jaune d’œuf/lait.

la cuisson dans l’Air Fryer (Ninja) @ninja.france environ 15 minutes, jusqu’à ce qu’ils soient bien dorés. À la sortie, badigeonnez-les immédiatement du beurre à l’ail et au persil.

✳️ Como quizá ya sepas (o no), el proceso de fermentación es algo mágico y, sobre todo, "vivo".

✳️ La fecha de caducidad en la caja se refiere solo al producto envasado al vacío. Una vez liberado de su envoltorio compostable, la fermentación se reactiva.

✳️ Además, el proceso de curación también se reinicia: el producto se seca, el sabor se intensifica y, lo mejor de todo, no se estropea, 🌱🧀 siempre que lo conserves en las condiciones adecuadas.

💚 Enjoy it at your own rhythm: once opened, it does not expire. The fermentation process is magical.

✳️ Many of you, especially those of you who live alone, ask us about the expiry dates of our vegetable delicacies. Therefore, we would like to clarify how the shelf life of our vegetables works.

✳️ As you may (or may not) already know, the fermentation process is something magical and, above all, ‘alive’.

✳️ The best-before date on the box refers only to the vacuum-packed product. Once released from its compostable packaging, fermentation is reactivated.

✳️ In addition, the curing process is also restarted: the product dries out, the flavour intensifies and, best of all, it does not spoil, as long as you keep it in the right conditions.

Арықтаймын деген адам бірінші стрессті азайтып, тамақтану тәртібін қадағалау қажет🙌🏻

1. Дефицит калорий салмақ тастаудың жалғыз ғылыми дәлелденген факторы. 1 сағат белсенді кардио немесе силовой жаттығу орта есеппен 300–500 ккал жұмсайды.
 Ал бұл жұмсалған энергияны бір өніммен (мысалы  круассан немесе тәтті кофемен)  қайта орнына келтіру өте оңай.

2. Жаттығудан кейінгі тәбет пен физиологиялық компенсация болады. Яғни спортпен айналысқаннан кейін организм ағзадағы энергия қорын толтыру үшін аштық гормондарын (грелин) белсендірек бөле бастайды. Адам бейсаналы түрде:
 Тамақты бұрынғыдан көп жеп қоюы мүмкін («бүгін жаттығуға бардым, маған болады» деген психологиялық жағдай).
 Жаттығудан кейін қалған күні бойы аз қозғалып, дене белсенділігін төмендетіп алады (компенсаторлық демалыс).

3. Салмақ таразыда өзгермеуі мүмкін
Спортқа жаңадан келгенде денеде бұлшықет массасы артып, май қабаты азаяды. Бұлшықет майға қарағанда тығыз әрі ауыр. Соның салдарынан дене мүсіні (көлем) тартылып, әдеміленіп жатса да, таразыдағы сан жылжымауы немесе тіпті артуы мүмкін.

4. Тамақтану 80%, Спорт  20%
 Рационда белоктың, пайдалы майлардың және баяу көмірсулардың жеткілікті болуы, өңделген қант пен трансмайларды азайту арықтаудың басты факторы.

Сүтқышқылды бактериялар лактозаны сүт қышқылына айналдырады, ақуыз ұйып, қою әрі крем тәрізді текстура түзеді 🤍

1️⃣ Сүтті 40–42°C дейін жылытып алыңыз (қайнатпаймыз). ( өлшейтін құралды каспийден алсаңыздар болады) 
2️⃣ Йогуртты қосамыз. Түйіршіктер қалмас үшін оны алдымен аздаған сүтпен араластырып алған ыңғайлы.
3️⃣ Таза банкаға құйыңыз (сумен шайып алған дұрыс).
4️⃣ Орамалға орап, 50°C дейін қыздырылып, өшірілген пешке түнге қалдырыңыз.
5️⃣ Таңертең текстурасы тұрақтануы үшін тоңазытқышқа 4–5 сағатқа қойыңыз.

🌙 LOW ON MAGNESIUM – STRUGGLING TO SLEEP DEEPLY OR FULLY RELAX?

If you get enough sleep but still feel tired, find it hard to relax, or often feel anxious without knowing why, your body may be low in Magnesium – a mineral that contributes to normal nerve and muscle function and supports the body’s ability to relax. 

🦐 Animal-based protein: Salmon and shrimp provide magnesium along with nutrients like Omega-3, zinc and vitamin B12, which help reduce stress and support heart health.

🥬 Plant-based protein: Spinach and edamame add fiber, minerals and plant-based protein, making them a light and wholesome choice for everyday meals and supporting a healthy digestive system.

🍚 Complex carbohydrates: Brown rice and fusilli help create a more balanced meal while providing magnesium from food, supporting stable blood sugar and helping the body relax.

Your soulmate just needs to choose the right nutrient-rich foods - a simple little way to take care of your body every day. 💚

𝚒𝚗𝚐𝚛𝚎𝚍𝚒𝚎𝚗𝚝𝚒:
200gr latte di soia senza zuccheri
100gr acqua (o altro latte)
25gr cacao amaro magro @prozis 
10gr amido di mais
2/3gr agar agar @prozis
dolcificante q.b.
35gr caseine / proteine vegetali gusto cioccolato @prozis

𝑝𝑟𝑜𝑐𝑒𝑑𝑖𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡𝑜:
In un pentolino unisci il cacao setacciato, l’amido di mais, l’agar agar e il dolcificante. Aggiungi gradualmente il latte, mescolando con una frusta per evitare la formazione di grumi.

Porta il pentolino sul fuoco a fiamma medio-bassa e continua a mescolare lentamente. Quando il composto inizierà ad addensarsi, spegni il fuoco.

Lascia intiepidire per un minuto, poi aggiungi la caseina e mescola energicamente fino ad ottenere un composto cremoso. Se dovessero formarsi dei grumi, puoi passare velocemente il minipimer.🤎

Versa il budino in una ciotola (o più coppette piccole) e lascia riposare in frigorifero per almeno 3/4 ore

Una volta solidificato puoi mangiarlo direttamente dalla coppetta oppure rovesciarlo su un piattino e decorare con le stelline di zucchero!

Gut health is key for optimal health and if we don’t focus on optimizing the gut, your entire body will not function optimally.

Healing your gut health is not just about taking the Gl Map test and taking one supplement. You must take a look at each one of these areas or further imbalances and inflammation can persist.

5️⃣ Areas To Focus On When Healing The Gut:

1. Support digestion: This is crucial because if we aren’t supporting digestion, then this can cause stress on our immune system and feed the wrong types of bacteria.

2. Eradicate parasites, pathogens, or yeast: If your results show any type of overgrowth, it is crucial we get rid of it. However, JUST doing this will not fix your issues if we do not address the other issues.

3. Repopulate beneficial bacteria: When you get rid of the overgrowths or bacteria that we do not want, we have to reinoculate the gut with beneficial bacteria.

4. Support the immune system: Infections and imbalances in the gut can be stressful for our immune system. we have to support the immune system so we can prevent future infections. Remember that 70-80% of your immune system is in the gut

5. Reduce stress: Managing stress is KEY for the gut healing journey. Chronic stress can cause tons of gut issues in the first place. If we you do NOT address lifestyle stressors, you will not heal.

🥞 MEGA FLUFFY CREPES (SANS ŒUFS, SANS LAIT & SANS MATIÈRE GRASSE !) 🥞

Vous avez KIFFÉ la VERSION PANCAKES 
 

 Vous m'avez défié en demandant une VERSION SANS OEUFS
SANS LAIT
SANS HUILE ?

 Ne bougez pas, enregistrez, likez, partagez et abonnez vous a @MESECYM_. , 

 Je vous donne DESSUITE la 
 RECETTE PARFAITE (Pour 3 pancakes XXL) 👇🏼

 INGRÉDIENTS :
 - 150g de farine de blé 
 - 20g de sucre (erythritol)
 - 1 c. à café de levure chimique 
 - ½ c. à café de bicarbonate de soude 
 - 1 pincée de sel 
 - 160ml d'eau tiède 
 - 1 c. à soupe de vinaigre d'alcool (blanc) ou jus de citron 🍋
 - 1 c. à café d'extrait de vanille 

👉🏻 PRÉPARATION 
- Dans un verre, mélangez l'eau tiède et le vinaigre blanc Laissez reposer 2 min.

- Dans un saladier, mélangez tous les ingrédients secs (farine, sucre, levure, bicarbonate, sel)

- Verse le liquidez et la vanille au centre. Mélangez brièvement au fouet : la pâte doit rester très épaisse et avec des grumeaux, c'est le secret du volume !
 Laissez reposer 5 min.

- Faites chauffer la poêle à feu doux 
- Graissez très légèrement et Versez une bonne épaisseur de pâte

Dès que de jolies bulles se forment à la surface, hop, retournez-le délicatement ! Laissez cuire encore 2 min sur l'autre face

Il ne reste plus qu'à ajouter un filet de sauce choco, des fruits ou ce que tu veux et déguster bien chaud !

Le concept est simple : on dépose un cookie bien chaud et au cœur encore fondant directement sur une boule de glace à la vanille, avant de le casser à la cuillère pour manger le tout ensemble.... 🤤

Regardez-moi ce cœur fondant, le chocolat qui coule... C'est indécent 😍

🍪 RECETTE - 6 gros cookies

- 115g beurre mou
- 100g cassonade + 50g sucre blanc
- 1 oeuf + 1 jaune
- 1 c.à.c vanille
- 200g farine + 1 c.à.c maïzena + 1/2 c.à.c bicarbonate + pincée de sel
- 200g chocolat au lait coupé en gros carrés
- Fleur de sel

Préparation :

1. Fouette le beurre mou avec les deux sucres pendant 2 min. 

2. Ajoute l'œuf, le jaune et la vanille. Mélange juste ce qu'il faut. 

3. Ajoute la farine, la maïzena, le bicarbonate et le sel. Ne travaille pas trop la pâte. 

4. Incorpore 150g de chocolat. Garde 50g pour la fin. 

5. Forme 6 grosses boules de 90g. Laisse la texture rugueuse

 6. Mets au frigo pendant 1h. C'est obligatoire pour l'épaisseur. 

7. Enfourne à 175°C pendant 11 à 12 min. Ils doivent paraître pas cuits au centre. 

8. À la sortie du four, pose le chocolat restant et la fleur de sel. Il va fondre tout seul. 

Tu poses le cookie encore chaud sur 2 boules de glace vanille. Tu casses à la cuillère.

بوریتو خوشمزه‌ترین غذای مکزیکی نیست؟ 🌯

اول برنجش رو آماده کن؛ یک پیمانه برنج شسته شده رو با پوره گوجه فرنگی، سس فلفل، نمک و کمی رب بذار بپزه و بعد دم بذار. 

برای مواد گوشتی پیاز نگینی و سیر رو تفت بده و گوشت رو بهش اضافه کن. ادویه ها (پودر سیر، پاپریکا، نمک، فلفل سیاه و پول بیبر) و یکم رب گوجه اضافه کن و در تابه رو برای ۱۰ دقیقه بذار تا خوب بپزه. بعد بهش قارچ اسلایس شده و ذرت اضافه کن و بعد کمی تفت دادن مواد گوشتی آماده ست.

یه سالاد تازه هم برای تاپینگ درست کن چون خیلی حس تازگی بوریتو رو زیاد میکنه؛ گوجه ، پیاز و جعفری (یا گشنیز) رو با لیمو و نمک و فلفل ترکیب کن.

حالا نوبت پیچیدن تورتیلاهاست. روی تورتیلا هر پنیری که دوست دارید میتونید بزنید ولی پیشنهاد من پنیر با طعم زیره ست. بعد برنج، مواد گوشتی، خوراک لوبیا چیتی و سالادی که اماده کردید رو اضافه کنید و مثل من که توی ویدیو نشون دادم بپیچید.

حالا قسمت جذاب این رسپی اینجاست؛ کمی پنیر پیتزا (موتزارلا) رو بذارید روی تابه داغ نچسب گرم بشه و بوریتو رو بذارید روی پنیر و تا وقتی که لبه هاش طلایی میشه اجازه بدید کریسپی و طلایی بشه.

مربای پوست پسته؛
یه چیزی که شاید تا حالا امتحانش نکرده باشی!
اگه مثل من عاشق مرباهای متفاوتی، این یکی رو حتماً امتحان کن😍
این‌بار پوست پسته‌های تازه رو دور نریختم و باهاشون یه مربای خوش‌عطر و متفاوت درست کردم.

مواد لازم:
• پوست پسته تازه: ۱ کاسه
• شکر: ۳۰۰ گرم
• آب: ۲۰۰ گرم
• هل: ۳ عدد
• زعفرون دم‌کرده
• آب‌لیمو: ۱ قاشق چای‌خوری
• مغز پسته‌ها هم به دلخواه 

طرز تهیه:
پوست پسته‌ها رو چند بار با آب بشور و داخل آب جوش حدود ۱۰ دقیقه بجوشون. آبکش کن و این کار رو ۲–۳ بار تکرار کن تا تلخی پوست گرفته بشه و مربا گس نشه.
بعد شکر و آب رو روی حرارت بذار تا شکر حل بشه و شهد کمی قوام بیاد. هل رو اضافه کن که عطر بیشتری به شهد بده. پوست پسته رو اضافه کن و با حرارت ملایم حدود ۳۰–۴۰ دقیقه بذار بپزه و شهد به غلظت مناسب برسه.
نکته‌ی مهم اینکه حتما حرارت ملایم باشه و هم نزنین که پسته‌ها از شکل نیفتن.
در آخر زعفرون دم‌کرده، مغز پسته و آب‌لیمو رو اضافه کن و بعد از چند دقیقه حرارت رو خاموش کن. بذار کاملاً خنک بشه و بعد داخل شیشه تمیز بریز. ✨
من برای این رسپی، پسته و بقیه میوه‌ها و سبزیجاتی که لازم داشتم رو از سرویس میوه اُکالا تهیه کردم؛ خرید آنلاین میوه و سبزیجات، بدون دردسر رفتن تا میوه‌فروشی و با ارسال رایگان.
چیزی که برام مهمه اینه که تازگی میوه‌ها تضمین شده و اگه کیفیت محصول مورد رضایت نباشه، امکان مرجوعی هم وجود داره.

My favorite part of the day is creating new recipes for @lynn.wholefoods and adjusting preexisting ones to better improve health 👍🏾

Today, I adjusted our cold-pressed Orange Juice to include the ‘pith’ (the spongy white stuff between the peel/zest and the fruit). 

Oranges are already a great source of Vitamin C. By crushing and adding the pith I have increased the nutritional value of this product to include other vitamins and minerals such as Vitamin A, B vitamins, calcium, and potassium. 

I have also increased the dietary fiber which can aid digestion, promote regular bowel movement, and support overall gut health. Fiber also helps regulate blood sugar levels and can contribute to weight management. 

It is important to mention at this point that the taste and texture of this product has been slightly affected because of the bitter aftertaste of the pith. 

I choose health over taste any day, but maybe that’s just me😅

✅Сегодня в AVOKA был Рыбный день .

мы обычно ставим именно на середину недели: он получается легче по ощущениям, но при этом остаётся полноценным и сытным.

Сегодня в рационе:

🥑Белая рыба + тёплый овощной салат — брокколи, запечённый кабачок, стручковая фасоль, картофель по-деревенски и наш соус гуакамоле с чесноком.

🥑Шашлычок на шпажке — с рисом, свежим салатом с адыгейским сыром и соусом из грецких орехов.

🥤 На перекус — смузи на кокосово-миндальном молоке: груша, банан и ягоды.

В этом и есть принцип AVOKA: мы не стараемся сделать каждый отдельный день одинаковым по плотности. Мы смотрим на рацион всей недели. Более лёгкий рыбный день сменяется более насыщенным мясным, чередуются крупы, овощи, разные источники белка и способы приготовления. Поэтому питание не надоедает и остаётся разнообразным и сбалансированным.

А уже завтра будет совсем другое настроение: стейк, паста с куриными тефтелями в сливочном соусе и новый перекус. У нас каждый день меняется — но вся неделя складывается в одну продуманную систему. 💚

Мы хотим, чтобы полезная еда для ребёнка перестала выглядеть «скучной и полезной».

MÙA HÈ KHÔNG HĂM - 5 Cách mẹ Sam giữ cho cô công chúa nhỏ luôn có làn da khô thoáng ⛅️ 

Sam là một em bé gái có làn da nhạy cảm. Vừa tròn tháng em đã bị vdcđ chảy dịch và phải dùng cort. Kèm với đó trong tháng luôn xì xoẹt nên em hay bị hăm đỏ, nhưng đấy chỉ là khi mẹ chưa làm những điều sau. Còn từ khi mẹ tuân theo thì không còn như vậy nữa: 

1. Tắm xong lau khô tất cả các kẽ da
Ẩm là nguyên nhân đầu tiên dẫn đến hăm, nên mẹ cần đảm bảo việc rửa ráy, tắm táp cho con xong đều phải lau khô. Sam luôn được thấm lại bằng khăn xô sau khi rửa ráy. 

2. Thay bỉm 3 tiếng/lần khi sơ sinh, 4 tiếng/lần khi qua mốc 3m, đêm dùng bỉm siêu thấm hút và thay ngay khi con đi poo kể cả trong đêm. 

3. Dùng bỉm phù hợp với da con 
Sam đã dùng Moony Trắng khi NB, sau đó đổi qua Mamogom Premium & Dynamic (mẹ ưng chất của Premium hơn, quần Dynamic cạp cao hơi dày), bỉm đêm Gooby chưa đổi từ 2m tới giơ 

4. Xử lý ngay khi chớm hăm 
Tại các kẽ dễ hăm, ngay khi chớm đỏ mẹ đã dùng luôn kem hăm Bebble để dập hăm. Kèm với đó là rửa bằng nước lá chè xanh pha loãng/lá bàng đun cô đặc pha loãng. Rửa xong bôi kem thì chỉ 2 ngày là đỡ. 

5. Lau những vùng hăm đỏ nhẹ nhàng 
Khi bị hăm con rất đau thậm chí là rát, mẹ nên dùng lực nhẹ để lau cho con. Không miết quá mạnh sẽ làm hăm nặng hơn. 

Đây là những cách mẹ Sam đã và đang làm để giúp em bé có một làn da khoẻ mạnh. Nhất là con gái thì lại càng dễ hăm đỏ, nên các mẹ nào có con gái thì hãy lưu ý những cách Linh chỉ nhé ✨

Mùa này có nồi thịt kho ngon lành, ăn với xôi nóng hay cơm nóng thì cái nách tự nhiên giật giật luôn chứ đùa =)))))) Mời các mom tham khảo CT dưới đây để trổ tài nữ công gia chánh nha

Nguyên liệu: 
• 700gram thịt ba chỉ (mua thịt trong siêu thị sẽ có miếng thịt đẹp - mình mua BAF trong Aeon Max Value) 
• 2 thìa đường, 3 thìa dầu ăn
• 1 thìa mắm
• 1 gói xốt Barona Thịt Kho Tàu 
• Nước lọc 

Cách làm: 
1️⃣ Rửa sạch thịt, thái miếng bản to bằng 3 ngón tay, chần sơ rửa sạch. 
2️⃣ Cho dầu vào chảo, cho đường vào và bật lửa vừa để thắng đường tới khi đường chuyển màu cánh gián [đây là bước làm cho thịt màu đẹp hơn là thắng nước đường]

Een vakantie is geen pauzeknop van je gezonde levensstijl. En je hoeft na thuiskomst al helemaal niet te compenseren, te diëten of jezelf streng toe te spreken.

Je hoeft niet opnieuw te beginnen. Je mag gewoon verdergaan.

Dat is ook precies waar ik met mijn Zelfliefde Reset mee aan de slag ga. Niet leren hoe je nog strenger voor jezelf kunt zijn, maar hoe je weer leert luisteren naar je lichaam, je eetgedrag beter begrijpt en jezelf niet telkens opnieuw hoeft te ‘herpakken’.

Want de vrijheid begint wanneer je niet meer elke maandag opnieuw hoeft te beginnen. 🤍

🥣 Wist je dat niet alleen wat je eet, maar ook de volgorde waarin je het eet een verschil kan maken?

Op vakantie ziet mijn ontbijt er net wat anders uit. ☀️

Ik begin mijn dag met berries uit mijn webshop — een lekkere boost voor mijn darmgezondheid, met extra vitamines en antioxidanten. 🫐

Daarna eet ik yoghurt met fruit en granola.

Vervolgens komen de eitjes met spek, groenten en een broodje. 🍳🥓🥒

En als laatste… een heerlijke croissant. 🥐❤️

Waarom die volgorde?

De volgorde waarin je verschillende voedingsmiddelen eet, kan invloed hebben op hoe sterk je bloedsuikerspiegel na een maaltijd stijgt.

Door eerst te kiezen voor vezels en eiwitten en de meer koolhydraatrijke voeding later in je maaltijd te eten, kan je bloedsuikerstijging minder groot zijn dan wanneer je je maaltijd start met snelle koolhydraten.

En precies daarom bewaar ik mijn croissant voor het einde. 😉

Maar vooral: dit gaat niet over goed of fout eten.

Ik ben op vakantie. Ik geniet. Ik eet een croissant omdat ik daar zin in heb en ik hoef daar absoluut geen schuldgevoel over te hebben. ❤️

Voor mij is gezond leven juist die combinatie:
bewust kiezen, goed voor jezelf zorgen en volop kunnen genieten.

Geen verboden. Geen compenseren. Geen “maandag begin ik opnieuw”.

Gewoon lekker eten, genieten en daarna weer verder. 🤎

🍍 ZONBIJTJE… en meteen ook de laatste uit mijn reeks zomerse ontbijtjes 🥹☀️

Ik sluit deze heerlijke reeks af met een echte tropische topper: ananas-kokoscrumble met passievruchtyoghurt 🥥🍍✨

Warme, zoete ananas met een krokant laagje van amandel en kokos… gecombineerd met frisse, koude yoghurt en passievrucht. 🤤💛
Echt zo’n ontbijtje waarbij je het gevoel hebt dat je nog even op vakantie bent. 🌴☀️

Voor 1 persoon 🥣

🍍 Voor de ananas
• 200 g verse ananas, in blokjes

🥥 Voor de crumble
• 30 g amandelmeel
• 20 g kokosrasp
• 1 eetlepel honing
• 1 eetlepel gesmolten kokosolie

🥭 Voor de passievruchtyoghurt
• 200 g Skyr of naturel proteïneyoghurt
• 1 passievrucht
• Eventueel ½ eetlepel honing als je de yoghurt wat zoeter wilt

✨ Zo maak je hem:

1️⃣ Verwarm de oven voor op 180°C.
2️⃣ Doe de ananas in een klein ovenschaaltje.
3️⃣ Meng het amandelmeel, de kokosrasp, honing en kokosolie tot een kruimelig mengsel.
4️⃣ Verdeel de crumble over de ananas.
5️⃣ Bak 15 à 20 minuten, tot de crumble mooi goudbruin is.
6️⃣ Meng ondertussen de Skyr met het vruchtvlees van de passievrucht.
7️⃣ Serveer de warme ananascrumble met de koude passievruchtyoghurt en eventueel nog wat extra passievrucht bovenop. 🍍🥥✨

💡 Kleine tip: merk je dat je crumble na het mengen nog wat droog en poederig is? Voeg dan gerust ½ eetlepel extra kokosolie toe. De hoeveelheid vocht kan wat verschillen. 🤍

En daarmee zit mijn reeks ZONBIJTJES erop 🥹☀️🍓🍑🍍
Ik hoop dat ik je deze zomer heb kunnen inspireren om eens iets nieuws en lekkers te maken voor je ontbijt. 💛

👉 Sla dit ZONBIJTJE zeker op voor later! ✨

You do not get stronger in the gym. You get stronger after you leave it.

That sounds backwards until you see what the research measured:

Muscle repair stays raised for up to 48 hours after a lifting session (Phillips et al. 1997).
The biggest growth hormone pulse of the day hits right after you fall asleep, in deep sleep (Van Cauter & Plat 1996).
One night without sleep cut muscle building by 18 percent, even with protein on board (Lamon et al. 2021).
Lifters who rested 3 minutes between sets gained more strength and more muscle than lifters who rested 1 (Schoenfeld et al. 2016).
Strength holds for about three weeks with no training at all (Bosquet et al. 2013).

The takeaway: the workout breaks you down. Rest is when the body builds you back.

Soups work especially well because they can combine hydration and several nutrient-dense foods in one meal.

Ginger Chicken & Vegetable Soup pairs lean protein with vegetables and a warm broth, making it an easy option when you want something filling without being overly heavy. Ginger can also add flavor without relying on a rich sauce, while chicken helps make the soup more satisfying.

Lentil & Vegetable Soup brings more plant-based fiber and protein, while Miso Tofu Soup combines tofu, greens, seaweed, and fermented miso for a savory plant-based option. These soups can be especially useful when you want meals built around vegetables while still including a meaningful source of protein.

The Detox Green Soup is packed with foods like broccoli, zucchini, leafy greens, and celery, while Carrot Ginger Soup offers a simpler vegetable-forward combination with naturally sweet carrots and warming ginger. There’s no single soup that “detoxes” the body, but meals like these can make it easier to return to your normal eating pattern after a few richer meals.

Everyone’s digestion is different, so choose the ingredients that sit well with you. Lentils and cruciferous vegetables can cause more gas or bloating for some people, while miso can contribute a fair amount of sodium depending on how much is used.

Loaded Garlic Butter Steak Sweet Potato 🥩🍠✨
(via @prepwithdrew)

This baked sweet potato is loaded with garlicky butter-seared sirloin, tender-crisp asparagus, fresh parsley, and grated Parmesan. It’s a hearty combination of savory steak, caramelized sweet potato, and rich garlic butter in every bite. 🤤

💾 SAVE this recipe for your next protein-packed dinner & SHARE it with someone who loves steak and sweet potatoes!

🛒 Ingredients
• 200g baked sweet potato
• 8 oz (227g) cooked top sirloin steak, cut into cubes
• Salt, black pepper & garlic powder, to taste
• 1 tsp beef tallow
• 1 tbsp light butter
• 4 garlic cloves, minced
• Fresh parsley
• 10g freshly grated Parmesan
• 5–6 asparagus spears

👩‍🍳 Directions
Bake the sweet potato at 425°F (220°C) for 50–60 minutes. Slice it open and fluff the inside with a fork.
Season the steak with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat a stainless-steel pan over high heat. Add the beef tallow and sear the steak for approximately 2 minutes per side.
Lower the heat, then add the light butter and minced garlic. Toss for 30–45 seconds, finish with fresh parsley, and remove the steak from the pan.
Cook the asparagus in the same pan until tender-crisp.
Load the sweet potato with the garlic-butter steak and asparagus, then finish with the grated Parmesan.

Macros: ~750 calories | ~76g protein | ~42g carbs | ~29g fat

💡 Pro Tip: Pat the steak dry and leave space between the pieces in the pan so they develop a golden sear instead of steaming.

Creamy Mushroom Chicken & Hasselback Potatoes 🍗🥔 ✨
(via @foodie_mette)

Golden chicken gets coated in a creamy mushroom sauce with garlic, thyme, and Dijon. Buttery Hasselback potatoes add plenty of crispy edges to this cozy dinner. 🤤

💾 SAVE this recipe for your next cozy dinner & SHARE it with a mushroom lover!

🛒 Ingredients (Serves 2–3)
Chicken
* 2 large chicken breasts
* Salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, chili flakes & oregano
* Olive oil
Mushroom Sauce
* 10.5 oz / 300 g mushrooms, sliced
* 2 shallots, finely chopped
* 3–4 garlic cloves, minced
* 1 tbsp butter
* ⅓–½ cup / 100–150 ml chicken stock
* 1¼ cups / 300 ml cooking cream
* 1 tsp Dijon mustard
* 1 tsp fresh thyme
* Lemon juice, to taste
* Salt & pepper
Hasselback Potatoes
* 6–8 medium potatoes
* 3 tbsp melted butter
* 2 tbsp olive oil
* Salt & pepper
* 1 tsp paprika
To Serve: Green beans, broccoli or asparagus

👩‍🍳 Directions
1. Thinly slice potatoes without cutting through. Brush with butter and olive oil; season with salt, pepper and paprika. Bake at 220°C (425°F) for 30 minutes.
2. Slice chicken horizontally into thinner pieces. Season with the listed seasonings. Heat olive oil in a pan; cook chicken until golden and 165°F (74°C) inside. Set aside.
3. Brush potatoes again with butter, getting between the slices. Bake for another 20–25 minutes, until crispy.
4. Melt butter in the chicken pan. Brown mushrooms in batches if needed. Return all mushrooms to the pan; add shallots, garlic and thyme. Cook briefly.
5. Add stock and scrape up the browned bits. Stir in cream and Dijon. Simmer 5–8 minutes, until slightly thickened. Season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
6. Return chicken and simmer 2–3 minutes, spooning sauce over it. Serve with potatoes and your chosen vegetables.

💡 Pro Tip: Place a potato between two chopsticks when slicing to help prevent cutting all the way through.

* 1 apple
* Cinnamon
* Honey, plus more for topping
* Vanilla bean ice cream
* Granola (peanut butter granola)

👩‍🍳 Directions
1. Cut the apple in half and scoop out the seeds.
2. Place the halves in the air fryer, generously sprinkle with cinnamon and drizzle with honey.
3. Air fry at 400°F for about 15 minutes, until soft and caramelized. Alternatively, bake in the oven at 400°F until tender.
4. Top with a scoop of vanilla bean ice cream, granola and an extra drizzle of honey.

💡 Pro Tip: Let the apples cool slightly before adding the ice cream so your scoop doesn’t melt immediately.
